_doc: US FHA Section 242 hospital muni universe — Signal OS scoping pass to validate fha_section_242 masking mechanism (Cal-Mortgage analog hypothesis)
_methodology: Active FHA 242 portfolio sourced from HUD '242_All_Historical_Deals.xlsx' (94 active loans, 69 unique obligors, $8.66B mortgage). Top 15 obligors by mortgage exposure pulled for operator-credit signals (CMS distress, going-concern, layoffs, bankruptcy) and bond-spread anchors where available. Time-boxed at 90 min; deeper data possible.
_data_sources: Crain's New York / Brooklyn Paper / Buffalo News / news reports for operator distress

primary_evidence.trigger: Default + FCA fraud case (overstated physician support / kickback schemes)

primary_evidence.obligor: LRGHealthcare (Lakes Region General + Franklin), Laconia NH
primary_evidence.trigger: Ch.11 bankruptcy after years of operational distress; sold to Concord Hospital for $30M
primary_evidence.note: Still listed as 'Active' in HUD historical-deals file ($135M total) but the originating LRG entity defaulted; claim event tested the program.

_historical_claims.implication: Unlike CSFA LCFF intercept (only Tri-Valley), FHA 242 has at least 2 large stress-tested claims. HUD absorbed losses; bondholders/GNMA holders were paid per guarantee. Does NOT undermine masking thesis (wrap held), but confirms the underlying-operator risk is real.

obligors_top15.name: St. Luke's-Roosevelt Hospital (now Mount Sinai West/Morningside)

bond_spread_signal.interpretation: Mount Sinai parent has been stress-tested; FHA wrap on the legacy St. Luke's series likely insulating bondholders

obligors_top15.verdict: WATCH — distressed parent, but wrap holds; system reportedly back to operating income 2025

obligors_top15.name: Maimonides Medical Center

operator_signals.operating_margin_trend: SEVERELY DETERIORATING — $375M cumulative loss 2021-2024, $85M Q1 2025 loss (+39% YoY), $15M loss through Q3 2025
operator_signals.state_relief: $1.2B state emergency funding + $183M Medicaid 1115 waiver + FEMA

bond_spread_signal.fha_242_bond_examples_outstanding: DASNY Maimonides FHA-Insured Series 2020 ($135.8M); also GNMA Collateralized Taxable Series 2013 ($100.5M Aaa/AA+)
bond_spread_signal.load_bearing_finding: FHA-Insured 'Aa1/AA+' bond trades AT OR WIDER than A-rated muni curve despite Aa1 wrap. This is HONEST PARTIAL MASKING — wrap compresses but does NOT fully decouple price from underlying operator distress.

obligors_top15.verdict: EXCLUDE — severe operator distress; bond market IS pricing in some risk premium despite wrap
